decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at E595-06 (15.4 g/t, 260 t ≈ 129 oz) with a likely repair at 13:20. The radio and CMMS agree, so there is no CONFIRM-01 issue. Central is truck-limited (inflow 159 t/h against 91 t/h of truck capacity), so LH-06 leaving C564-01 (5.8 g/t) costs almost nothing. Este has spare truck capacity and a 170 t stockpile buffer. LH-06 is a LH514 (42 t/h) and arrives in 0.49 h, so it can finish the 260 t by about 16:00. That is about 128 oz, less roughly 5 oz of loss at Central. I did not use the development loaders: LH-09 costs 4 oz/h and LH-08 costs 1.9 oz/h, and both are slower LH410s. LH-10 is not available until 11:00.
